---
name: 💡 Feature Request
about: Propose a new feature, enhancement, or subsystem
title: 'feat: [Short description of feature]'
labels: ['enhancement', 'feature-planning']
assignees: ''
---

## 🎯 The Problem / Goal
* What problem does this feature solve?
* What is the final goal of this enhancement?

## 📋 Proposed Implementation
Describe the proposed solution in detail. Include any structural adjustments to:
* Desktop client (React + Tauri)
* CLI tool
* Core libraries (`ollama-core`, `ollama-api`, or `ollama-plugins`)

## ✅ Acceptance Criteria
List the specific check boxes that must be met to mark this feature complete:
- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2

## ⚡ Risks & Dependencies
* Are there any breaking changes to current workflows?
* Does this require new external dependencies?

## 🛠 Technical Notes
Any architectural suggestions, memory layout designs, or performance profiles to consider.
